record.title: Compose owned transport for remaining native transitions
record.intent: Retain known native transitions while replacing their older host transport lifetime.
requirements: Adapt only the preserved remaining-transition generator to the independently proved owned V5 foreground-server lifetime and bounded readiness. Preserve exact original native deployment/removal, protected-content checks, normal reboot intent and one normal reboot per transition. Do not execute a controller or change source/wiring/firmware/entitlements/calibration during this offline task.

Before and after a transition require exact owned account/PID/birth/executable and liveness before each retained CLI. Prove local absence then one connect and uniqueDEVICE within20seconds. Use only original allowed UID-first bounded conditional postboot root setup and one distinct post-root readiness; no daemon properties/remount or failed-session retry. Retire owned process and all sockets before alias removal; uncertaintyHOLD.

Derived transition must bind actual accepted A1/currentstock ArmReady and separately verified existing lease. Final-stock must bind actual accepted B/derived ArmReady and its newly captured postreboot lease. Generic preparation must not manufacture these future bindings. Require exact fresh UI/stock-or-derived policy/protected corpus and serviced1801secondwarm-up per transition. Graceful capture/drop statistics and current isolation remain mandatory.

Retain frozen75slot protocol, values, source schedule, numerical criteria and harddeadline. Independently compare concrete generator/diffs and inherited callback semantics; targeted changed owned/lease/epoch negatives plus strict authoredtyping/Ruff/format. Record exact preparation and future-binding requirements; do not claim execution readiness from uninstantiated templates.
acceptance: Concrete offline composition is independently reviewed and frozen or explicitly held; no physical result is inferred.
